pages.title: Spice Grinder
pages.text: This nifty mortar and pestle is used to crush and blend spices and directly apply them to foods. It can be used in item form or placed down when sneaking. Any in-progress runs are saved on the item or block.
Hard, volcanic rock is required to crush spices without chipping and seasoning food with pebbles.
